summary: Backend persistence/dedup/analyze-all is verified GREEN (10/10 pytest in test_connect_transcript_persistence.py, same as iter22 — no regression). The preview-bundle blocker IS fixed: the served HTML now contains /static/js/bundle.js, React mounts, sidebar+stepper+form render with data-testid='business-case-flow-page' and 'stepper-connect' present. HOWEVER the V1 multi-transcript persistence fix UI is STILL not testable at the requested URL because of a routing mismatch (see RCA): /v3/admin/business-cases/:id/connect/schedule resolves to V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule from V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js (the SHORT single-transcript variant with `connect-save-meeting-btn` and no add/multi-transcript buttons). The fix code (sort, de-dup, hydrate ALL meetings) lives only in V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js which is exclusively routed under /admin/* — and that path is gated by ProtectedRoute(['admin']) and Navigates unauthenticated users to '/'. Confirmed by direct Playwright visit to /admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule -> 302-like client redirect to landing page (no flow-page, 0 of the V1 multi-transcript testids). The data-testids `connect-add-transcript-btn`, `connect-transcript-content-<sid>`, `connect-analyze-all-btn`, `connect-save-btn` therefore DO NOT exist on the served React tree at the URL specified in the review request.

integration_issues.issue: The fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js lines 1001-1035 (sort by date, dedupe by id, setTranscriptSessions(uniqueMeetings.map(...))) is NOT reachable at /v3/admin/business-cases/:id/connect/schedule — that URL is routed in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 496 to V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule imported from V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js (single-transcript variant). The V1 component is only routed under /admin/* (App.js lines 379-385, ProtectedRoute(['admin'])). Visiting /admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule unauthenticated redirects to '/' (LandingPage with 'Enter Demo' CTA, no flow-page, 0 transcript testids).

action_items: Decide which variant is the canonical Connect flow. The V1 multi-transcript flow (which contains the recent persistence fix being regression-tested) is currently orphaned behind /admin/* ProtectedRoute. Either: (a) rewire /v3/admin/business-cases/:id/connect/schedule -> V1BusinessCaseConnectSchedule and /v3/admin/business-cases/:id/connect/questions -> V1BusinessCaseConnectQuestions in /app/frontend/src/App.js lines 496-499 (swap the imports), OR (b) port the persistence fix (loadMeetings -> sort+dedupe+hydrate-all + saveConnectTranscriptSessions + TranscriptUploadPanel) into V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule in V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js, OR (c) drop the ProtectedRoute('admin') gate for the preview environment so /admin/* can be exercised by Playwright the same way /v3/admin/* is.

After the above wiring/port is done, re-run the Playwright assertions: 4 transcripts persist after navigate-away+return, F5 dedup holds, 5th appends without dropping previous 4, analyze-all backend log shows transcript_count=4 then 5, no duplicate POST spam (page.on('request') count == sessions count).
Consider adding a DELETE /api/v3/meetings/{id} endpoint to make UI tests self-clean without direct Mongo writes.
critical_code_review_comments: The codebase has TWO V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule components (V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js exports it; V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js also exports it). App.js disambiguates by aliasing V1's export to V1BusinessCaseConnectSchedule. This dual-export of the same symbol from two files is a maintainability hazard — the V1 file should rename its exports to V1BusinessCaseConnectSchedule, etc., so a code reader cannot accidentally hit the wrong component. (Same applies to all 18 paired Connect/Frame/Plan/Delivery pages.)

V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js at 4159 lines and V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js at 2817 lines both massively exceed the 700-line guideline. Splitting per phase (Connect, Frame, Plan, Delivery, Reporting) is overdue.

/app/frontend/craco.config.js previously had a custom middleware that served public/index.html bypassing webpack-injected scripts. That has been removed (verified — HTML now contains /static/js/bundle.js). Good fix. Leave a comment in craco.config.js documenting the removal so it isn't re-added.

loadMeetings in V1 lines 1008-1011 sorts via String.localeCompare on call_date || scheduled_for || created_at. Works for ISO-8601 but breaks silently for mixed formats — add a normalizer or assert ISO format at the API boundary.
saveConnectTranscriptSessions re-uploads every session on each Analyze-All click even when content is unchanged — write amplification carried over from iter22 review, still present.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: routing/wiring mismatch in /app/frontend/src/App.js. Line 89 imports V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule from V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js as V1BusinessCaseConnectSchedule and wires it ONLY to /admin/business-cases/:id/connect/schedule (line 421), behind ProtectedRoute(['admin']) (lines 379-385). Line 66 imports the V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js version (single-transcript) and wires it to /v3/admin/business-cases/:id/connect/schedule (line 496). The review request expects multi-transcript testids (connect-add-transcript-btn etc.) to render at /v3/admin/.../connect/schedule, but those testids only exist in the V1 component. REPRODUCTION: (1) curl https://tasck-live-demo-1.preview.emergentagent.com/v3/admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule -> body renders the V3 'Schedule meeting' form with [data-testid="connect-save-meeting-btn"], NOT [data-testid="connect-save-btn"]. (2) Playwright visit to /admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule -> client-side redirect to '/' (LandingPage). MITIGATION: in App.js swap the imports on lines 496-499 to use the V1 aliases (V1BusinessCaseConnectSchedule/Questions/Analysis/Reschedule) so /v3/admin/.../connect/* renders the multi-transcript V1 components. This is the minimal one-file change. Alternative: port the V1 persistence fix (loadMeetings sort/dedupe/hydrate-all + TranscriptUploadPanel + connect-add-transcript-btn) into V3BusinessCaseConnectSchedule in V3BusinessCaseFlowPages.js. Backend persistence (lines 1001-1035 of V1) is independently proven correct by the existing 10/10 black-box pytest suite, so once the UI is rewired, the persistence behaviour itself should not need re-debugging — only the UI surface.
